scope: Xenia Edge native viewport host-sync runtime repair
behavior: Force Xenia Edge to GTK X11 backend.
Before the first large Xenia top-level X11 map, advertise WM_CLASS xenia_canary and _NET_WM_PID.
Map the frame and block the Xenia UI thread up to five seconds while Nougat v53 existing emulator host reparents it.
Resume Xenia only after the frame is no longer a root-level window, so render-panel surface creation occurs after embedding.
